comments.body: Answered as of af96f6f: `model` is not abstracted for personas. Delegates and skills render it from tai's own vocabulary; the Claude adapter's persona transform renders only `name` and `description`, so a persona that needs a model sets it under `native.claude`. Promoting `model` to persona vocabulary is a separate call - the test for promotion is how many targets share the concept.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
title: how does persona 'model' work? is it abstracted?
